answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public quartz ledger that cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent climbs to the summit of trusted standing once, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. An ivory record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
